issue: Data not persisted across page reload
actual: Prior to reload, dashboard had 5 resumes: original 3 (Product Designer, Marketing Manager, Software Engineer) plus 'Marketing Resume - Acme' (newly created) and 'Sales Manager Resume' (a renamed duplicate). After navigating to http://localhost:6005/ via a fresh page load (browser_navigate), the dashboard reverted to showing only the original 3 resumes ('Product Designer Resume', 'Marketing Manager Resume', 'Software Engineer Resume') — the created and duplicated resumes were gone. Confirmed via browser_evaluate that localStorage and sessionStorage are both empty (no keys), indicating state is held only in-memory (e.g., React state) with no persistence layer, so created/edited/duplicated/renamed resumes do not survive a reload.

evidence: Within the same session, created a new resume 'Marketing Resume - Acme' (distinct from the 3 pre-existing resumes) and additionally duplicated it and renamed the copy to 'Sales Manager Resume'. actual: Inspected the dashboard's full DOM and accessibility tree — the only filter/search controls present are a text search box ('Search resumes...') and a sort combobox (Newest First/Oldest First/Title A-Z/Title Z-A). There is no date filter control, date picker, or date-range input anywhere on the page (confirmed via browser_evaluate querying all `input` and `button` elements: only one text input and two buttons — 'New Resume' and the sort dropdown — exist). Users cannot filter saved resumes by exact creation date or date range.
